module_summary: Four-sample accumulator with output backpressure: each accepted cycle adds the 8-bit input into a 10-bit sum (reloading on the first of four), a 2-bit counter tracks the group, and a valid pulse presents the sum after the fourth sample.

anchors.name: n10_ddf
anchors.why: 10-bit running sum output, reloaded at group start and accumulated each accepted cycle.

anchors.name: n6_0e0
anchors.why: 8-bit input sample added into the sum.

anchors.name: n8_6c4
anchors.why: Output valid pulse after the fourth accumulated sample.

anchors.name: n11_44e
anchors.why: Downstream ready; with output valid low it allows accumulation to proceed.

anchors.name: n0_693
anchors.why: Sample counter 0..3; zero reloads the sum, three triggers output valid.

anchors.name: n2_dde
anchors.why: Accept enable, high when output not stalled; advances counter and sum.

anchors.name: n1_5ed
anchors.why: Group-complete flag: wraps counter and sets output valid.

groups.name: accumulator
groups.description: Running-sum registers with reload on first sample.

groups.name: group_control
groups.description: Accept logic, sample counter and output valid generation.
